description: Perfiles Eléctricos – Tomografía. Datos y Modelos (DAT) is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Geológico y Minero de España [EXTINTO]. Field data (resistivity– depth) and interpretations of electrical profiles. Coverage: Instituto Geológico y Minero de España [EXTINTO]. The portal shows the English title as "Electrical Profiles – Tomography. Data and Models (DAT)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Instituto Geológico y Minero de España [EXTINTO]. Its keywords include SIGEOF, Resistividad, Geofísica, Tomografía eléctrica. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.igme.es/condiciones-de-uso/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
